purpose: Machine-first technical distribution shortlist for API directories, agent registries and developer discovery surfaces.
primary_rule: Do not rely on human cold email. Prioritize machine-readable assets, public API documentation and sandbox-callable flows.

channels.name: Own domain machine surfaces
channels.why: Highest control and no platform dependency.

channels.name: GitHub repository
channels.why: Developers, crawlers and agents can inspect versioned docs and JSON assets.
channels.next_action: Add release notes and topics when useful.

channels.name: Postman Public API Network
channels.why: Strong API discovery surface; public workspaces help onboarding and search discovery.
channels.next_action: Use the Marketplace Publication Execution Pack and the public collection as the source copy. Keep workspace sandbox-only and publish no real API key.

channels.name: RapidAPI Hub
channels.why: API marketplace with provider dashboard, listing metadata, OpenAPI/docs and browser testing.
channels.next_action: Use https://machinesignal.it/marketplace_publication_execution_pack_20260606.json, https://machinesignal.it/marketplace_api_directory_pack_20260606.json and https://machinesignal.it/distribution/rapidapi-listing.json as the listing source. Keep monetized publication blocked.

channels.name: APILayer and curated API marketplaces
channels.why: Potential API buyer traffic, but may be curated and less self-service.
channels.next_action: Submit only sandbox-ready directory copy after owner approval, using the Marketplace Publication Execution Pack.

channels.name: Smithery
channels.why: Relevant for agent/tool discovery; current asset is a local stdio adapter plus wrapper pack, while a hosted MCP server is not live.
channels.next_action: Use the MCP manifest plus Marketplace Publication Execution Pack. Decide later whether a hosted MCP endpoint is needed for listing.

channels.name: Glama MCP registry
channels.next_action: Validate whether local stdio adapter listings are accepted or whether hosted MCP is required.

channels.name: AgentNDX
channels.why: Agentic registry focused on MCP, A2A and x402-enabled services.
channels.next_action: Build MCP/A2A or x402-compatible surface first.

channels.name: MCPDrop
channels.why: MCP directory, useful after tool wrapper exists.
channels.next_action: Prepare sandbox-only listing draft after validation.

recommended_next_steps: Publish and polish sandbox-only Postman public workspace copy.
Prepare RapidAPI and API directory listing fields from the Marketplace Publication Execution Pack.
Keep GitHub and own domain as canonical source of truth.
Validate the public MCP wrapper pack and prepare sandbox-only MCP directory drafts.
Use the MCP agent registry NoWrite rehearsal before considering hosted MCP or external registry submission.
Use the machine buyer end-to-end rehearsal as the current go/no-go evidence before hosted MCP, marketplace publication or paid checkout.

channel_decisions.next_step: Keep workspace private/team, import the public collection, run final in-Postman secret scan, then ask owner before public visibility.
Prepare provider/listing metadata only; keep paid plans, live checkout and production key distribution disabled.
Use the directory draft copy as metadata source only; public submission remains blocked until owner approval.
Prepare local-adapter registry metadata; decide separately if a hosted MCP endpoint is worth building before public registry submission.

recommended_sequence.channel: Own-domain API and agent discovery surfaces

latest_machine_channel_rehearsal_nowrite.recommended_next_step: Run a private Postman workspace rehearsal first, then prepare unpublished RapidAPI/API-directory/MCP registry drafts; keep monetization and public submission blocked.
latest_machine_channel_rehearsal_nowrite.interpretation: A machine can evaluate Postman, RapidAPI-style, generic API directory and MCP/agent registry drafts from public metadata. All channels are ready for owner-supervised NoWrite rehearsal; public submission, monetization, production keys, hosted MCP claims and human outreach remain blocked.

latest_postman_private_workspace_rehears.recommended_next_step: Keep Postman private/team, optionally run an owner-supervised in-Postman import check, then prepare unpublished API-directory or RapidAPI draft metadata only.

latest_api_marketplace_draft_rehearsal_n.recommended_next_step: Keep API-directory and RapidAPI-style assets as private/unsubmitted drafts; next run MCP/agent-registry draft rehearsal or prepare owner-supervised manual review without publishing.

latest_mcp_agent_registry_draft_rehearsa.recommended_next_step: Keep MCP/tool-registry as private draft/local adapter. Next decision: owner-supervised choice between building a hosted MCP endpoint or keeping local adapter and preparing unpublished registry metadata.
latest_mcp_agent_registry_draft_rehearsa.interpretation: A machine can discover the MCP manifest, registry draft, local adapter and evidence chain. The current channel is usable for private machine rehearsal, but it is intentionally not a live hosted MCP product and not monetized.
